name: Cerdà (Spain)
description: White field within a chequered border of yellow and black, charged at the hoist with a blue mount fleury between two blue cockerels and at the fly with a red tau cross.
history: The official flag of Cerdà is of proportions 2:3, white, at the hoist a mount fleury azure between two cockerels also azure, crested gules, beaked and armed or; it was approved by resolution of 4 March 2008 of the First Vice-President and Conseller of the Presidency and published in the DOCV of 4 April 2008.

features.role: chequered border of yellow and black
mount fleury between two cockerels at the hoist
tau cross at the fly and combs of the cockerels
